fields.Name: T105 - Query Drawer Unsaved-Changes Discard Confirm
fields.Description: Exercises the IsDrawerDirty snapshot comparison + MJConfirmService discard-confirm path on close — a dirty-state guard unique to this drawer, not the generic form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to Data Explorer, and open the Queries section. Open the New Query drawer via the '+' (New Query) icon button and type something into the Name field (making the drawer 'dirty'). Now try to close the drawer — click the X, click the backdrop outside the drawer, or press Escape. Success is that a confirmation dialog appears asking to discard unsaved changes (rather than silently closing). You can confirm the discard to close it. If the '+' button is absent due to permissions, report that. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: After editing a drawer field and attempting to close (X / backdrop / Escape), a discard-unsaved-changes confirmation prompt appears
Confirming the prompt closes the drawer without error
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
